## What's new
- **Air Traffic keeps itself up to date.** It looks for a new version once a day, and **Check for updates** in Settings → General looks right away. When an update arrives while you are busy, it waits quietly in the menu bar menu as "Update to …" instead of opening a window over your work. - This is the last version you install by hand. From here on, updates come to you.
